name: Obsidian Daily Widget
description: Shows today's Obsidian daily note tasks and a 7-day habit heatmap on New Tab and in the toolbar popup, with the same focus/planning/undone-tasks nag notifications as the iOS and Windows versions.
_comment_host_permissions: Required by declarativeNetRequest's redirect action, which (unlike a plain block) needs host access to the request being redirected. It has to be <all_urls> because the blocked-site list is user-editable at runtime and so can't be enumerated here. Nothing reads page content: there are no content scripts and no fetch to any of these hosts.
